arg.replaceable: show [PAGE] | add-nguid GUID REASON | remove-nguid GUID

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Requires C/nguidlist and confirmed internal GUID authentication for players. New entries require a 40-character hexadecimal Xmod GUID. Old Nitmod GUIDs remain visible and removable, but do not exempt Xmod players. Reasons contain 1 to 100 printable bytes. Show displays eight entries per page. Changes are saved immediately to g_vpnBlockerDBPath.
